answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37792 Country: India Title: My company is Project Company and takes project to manufacture hospitals, shopping malls, offices and banks. Every project takes at least 3 years Question: My company is Project Company and takes project to manufacture hospitals, shopping malls, offices and banks. Every project takes at least 3 years. This time they are putting me in a bank project for electrical part. Will my salary be halal? Answer ID: 37792 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 47/48/N=1433) The electric job in a bank is lawful and the salary shall be halal as one has not to deal with interest directly or help in it. If one can avoid it as well then it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
